description: Expected detections of network.windows rules per EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES file, from path-derived ATT&CK techniques (frozen host manifest) and the rule-to-technique map of design §5 only. Written before any detection was run on any sample. Exposed development evidence.
method: host-engine-v1 §3.2 and §4.7 item 3 (exact technique match), unchanged
split_rule: last hex digit of the content SHA-256: even -> development, odd -> report

limitations: No rule has an expected development-half sample: every shipped rule passes gate 2 only through its invented tests and ships unvalidated_on_samples, with confidence capped at single_signal.
N5 (DGA) would be validated by a labelled DGA list; UMUDGA is not used because it contains executables.
N8 (DNS tunnelling) has no public sample in Windows log form.
Labels are coarse: a name says what the lab exercised, not that every event is malicious.
